text: The first real two-worker diagnostic reached fork 4 with exact semantic proofs, then failed closed on a 1 ns JVM median mismatch: Scala Math.round used half-up while the runner, Python, and Julia use ties-to-even. Standardized JVM protocol rounding with Math.rint, added deterministic 2.5/3.5 regression coverage, and rebuilt the assembly. The failed diagnostic remains non-claim evidence under /tmp/grakern-performance-smoke.
